key_points.text: My guest this episode is Chris Sidiel, co-CIO of the Ambrose group, a volatility arbitrage focused firm founded in 2018.

key_points.text: Chris recently joined Ambris after spending several years on BMO's exotic and listed options desks.

key_points.text: While time on these desks gave Chris the experience of managing a large derivatives book.
key_points.evidence_quote: While time on these desks gave Chris the experience of managing a large derivatives book, what convinced him to take the leap to a new firm was growing confidence in a thesis that market microstructure had undergone a regime shift.

thesis: The episode discusses a market regime shift in microstructure that supports a volatility arbitrage approach consisting of long volatility dispersion trading and short volatility contango and convexity trades. The portfolio is designed so that positions in one sleeve offset risk in another to manage overall risk.
